briefdescription.para: Compute HMAC-SHA384 over data using secret key (RFC 4231).
SHA-512 & SHA-384 cryptographic hash and HMAC — pure C99, zero dependencies.

detaileddescription.para: Implements FIPS 180-4 compliant SHA-512 and SHA-384 secure hash algorithms and RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA512 / HMAC-SHA384 message authentication.
Follows the streaming pattern: init → update (repeated) → final
The context struct is caller-owned (~216 bytes on 32-bit/64-bit targets). Zero heap allocation, zero floating point.
